mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT a.nm, a.name, a.manager_id
FROM pa_custom_info a
WHERE a.nm IN
#{nm}
select manager_id from pa_custom_info group by manager_id
select manager_id, count(nm) as client_sum from pa_custom_info where manager_id is not null group by manager_id
select manager_id, count(nm) as client_sum from pa_custom_info where manager_id is not null and etl_dt >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), 1, 1) group by manager_id
select manager_id, count(nm) as client_sum from pa_custom_info where manager_id is not null and etl_dt >= DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), 1) group by manager_id
select manager_id, count(nm) as client_sum from pa_custom_info where manager_id is not null and etl_dt >= DATEADD(day, -1, CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) group by manager_id
select count(*) from pa_custom_info where township = #{townShip} and area = #{area} and DATE_FORMAT(allocation_date, '%Y') = #{thisYear} group by DATE_FORMAT(allocation_date, '%Y')
select count(*) from pa_custom_info where township = #{townShip} and area = #{area} and DATE_FORMAT(allocation_date, '%Y-%m') = #{thisMonth} group by DATE_FORMAT(allocation_date, '%Y-%m')
select count(*) from pa_custom_info where township = #{townShip} and area = #{area} and DATE_FORMAT(allocation_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{thisDay} group by DATE_FORMAT(allocation_date, '%Y-%m-%d')

select ci.nm, ci.name, ci.identify, ci.home_address, ci.contract_address, ci.outlet, ci.outlet_code, ci.township, ci.area, ci.manager_id, ci.work, ci.profession, ci.telephone, ci.gender, ci.marital_status, ci.type, ci.allocation_date, ci.etl_dt, coi.star from pa_custom_info as ci left join cust_other_info as coi on ci.nm = coi.nm where ci.nm = #{nm}
select count(ci.nm) total, coi.fc as fc from pa_custom_info as ci left join cust_other_info as coi on ci.nm = coi.nm where manager_id = #{code} group by coi.fc

select cs.manager_id as manager_id, (count(c1.nm) - count(ncs.nm)) as month1_dkzl, (count(c2.nm) - count(ncs.nm)) as month2_dkzl, (count(c3.nm) - count(ncs.nm)) as month3_dkzl, (count(c4.nm) - count(ncs.nm)) as month4_dkzl, (count(c5.nm) - count(ncs.nm)) as month5_dkzl, (count(c6.nm) - count(ncs.nm)) as month6_dkzl from pa_custom_info as cs left join (select manager_id, nm from pa_custom_info where datediff(month, etl_dt, getdate()) = 0) as c1 on cs.manager_id = c1.manager_id left join (select manager_id, nm from pa_custom_info where datediff(month, etl_dt, getdate()) = 1) as c2 on cs.manager_id = c2.manager_id left join (select manager_id, nm from pa_custom_info where datediff(month, etl_dt, getdate()) = 2) as c3 on cs.manager_id = c3.manager_id left join (select manager_id, nm from pa_custom_info where datediff(month, etl_dt, getdate()) = 3) as c4 on cs.manager_id = c4.manager_id left join (select manager_id, nm from pa_custom_info where datediff(month, etl_dt, getdate()) = 4) as c5 on cs.manager_id = c5.manager_id left join (select manager_id, nm from pa_custom_info where datediff(month, etl_dt, getdate()) = 5) as c6 on cs.manager_id = c6.manager_id left join (select manager_id, nm from pa_custom_info where datediff(month, etl_dt, getdate()) > 5) as ncs on cs.manager_id = ncs.manager_id group by cs.manager_id having cs.manager_id is not null
select count(ci.nm) total, coi.fc as fc from pa_custom_info as ci left join cust_other_info as coi on ci.nm = coi.nm where area_code = #{code} group by coi.fc

select count(ci.nm) total ,coi.fc as fc from pa_custom_info as ci left join cust_other_info as coi on ci.nm = coi.nm where ci.area_code = #{code} and year(coi.etl_dt) = #{year} group by coi.fc
select count(ci.nm) total ,coi.fc as fc from pa_custom_info as ci left join cust_other_info as coi on ci.nm = coi.nm where manager_id = #{code} and year(coi.etl_dt) = #{thisYear} group by coi.fc

select count(ci.nm) total ,coi.fc as fc from pa_custom_info as ci left join cust_other_info as coi on ci.nm = coi.nm where ci.area_code like (#{code}+'%') and year(coi.etl_dt) = #{year} group by coi.fc
select count(ci.nm) total ,coi.fc as fc from pa_custom_info as ci left join cust_other_info as coi on ci.nm = coi.nm where year(coi.etl_dt) = #{year} group by coi.fc
